title.overview: In and around Lucknow University in 1989, couples of varying ages explore the politics of love through marriage, budding romances and friendships.

title.name: The Penthouse
title.overview: Three women who live at Seoul's most luxurious penthouse apartment will stop at nothing to protect their status and their children's futures. But a murder at Hera leaves one mom questioning her place in this elite society and puts her on the road for revenge.

title.name: Flower of Evil
title.overview: Hiding a twisted past, a man maintains his facade as the perfect husband to his detective wife — until she begins investigating a series of murders.

title.name: 18 Again
title.overview: At a difficult place in his marriage and career, a middle-aged man gets a shot at a do-over when he's transformed back into his 18-year-old body.

title.name: The God of High School
altNames: THE GOD OF HIGH SCHOOL ゴッド・オブ・ハイスクール
title.overview: Jin Mori has proclaimed himself the strongest high schooler. His life changes when he's invited to participate in "God of High School," a tournament to determine the strongest high schooler of all. He's told that if he wins, any wish he makes will be granted... All the participants are powerful contenders who fight their hardest for their own wishes. What awaits them at the end of the tournament? A chaotic battle between unbelievably strong high school students is about to begin!

title.name: Noblesse

title.name: Extraterrestrial Life: How Close Are We to Finding Aliens? | Full Documentary
title.overview:
Are we alone in the universe, and what would happen if an advanced alien civilization found Earth? Scientists search for extraterrestrial life on Mars, icy moons and distant exoplanets while SETI listens for signals from intelligent civilizations. From 51 Pegasi b and Kepler-452b to the mysterious Wow! signal, the documentary examines how close humanity may be to discovering life beyond our planet.

But first contact could carry enormous risks. The film explores the Voyager Golden Record, the Arecibo Message, Breakthrough Starshot and the debate over deliberately announcing Earth's existence to the cosmos. Scientists and military experts then confront the darkest possibility: if a civilization capable of interstellar travel arrived as a conqueror, could humanity defend itself, or would technological superiority make an alien war impossible to win?

title.name: Leonard Ouzts | Lil Sumn Sumn (Full Comedy Special)
title.overview:
Leonard Ouzts delivers a sharp and personal stand-up set blending family stories, dating struggles, pop culture takes, and hilarious social observations. Growing up as a military brat in Chesapeake, Virginia, Leonard reflects on life with a Navy father, living in Japan after 9/11, and navigating parents returning to college while raising him. He shares funny and heartfelt stories about family dynamics, including being bribed with McDonald’s to keep secrets and coping with the loss of his mother before his father quickly remarried.
Now single at 33, Leonard dives into the chaos of modern dating, financial expectations, and his reluctance to become a “stepdaddy.” He hilariously explores attraction, intimacy, and social media dating culture.
From roasting Harry Potter fandom and explaining why Batman “has to be white,” to comparing black and white sleepovers and reflecting on his longtime barber, Leonard mixes vulnerability, sharp commentary, and laid-back charisma into a deeply funny hour of comedy.

title.name: Mystery of Dwarka | The Real History || Full Documentary
title.overview:
Mystery of Dwarka | The Real History || Full Documentary , The Real History of Dwarka that nobody tells you and the real story which we are going to cover in this video. 
Around 5,000 years ago, in the heart of the ocean, there stood a magnificent city — Dwarka. With over 900,000 palaces adorned with gold, diamonds, and precious gems, this city’s planning and architecture were so advanced that even today’s modern cities pale in comparison. But one day, in a sudden twist of fate, this glorious kingdom disappeared beneath the waves.

Fast forward to 1983 — near the coast of Okha in Gujarat, India. An archaeological dive led by the legendary Dr. S.R. Rao would challenge centuries of belief. Beneath the Arabian Sea, divers discovered colossal walls, intricately carved pillars, anchors, and artifacts that matched descriptions from the Mahabharata and Harivamsha Purana. Was this the submerged kingdom of Lord Krishna?

In this documentary, we uncover:
-The legendary creation of Dwarka and why it was destined to fall.
-The curse that shook the heavens and led to the city’s submergence.
-The groundbreaking underwater discovery of 1983 and how it rewrote  history. 
-Archaeological evidence dating back to the time of the Mahabharata war.

Combining mythology, history, and science, we take you deep into the Arabian Sea to explore one of the greatest archaeological mysteries of all time. Is Dwarka just a myth — or undeniable proof of our ancient heritage?

The Thinking Game takes you on a journey into the heart of leading AI lab DeepMind, capturing a team striving to unravel the mysteries of intelligence and life itself.

Filmed over five years by the award winning team behind AlphaGo, the documentary examines how DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis’s extraordinary beginnings shaped his lifelong pursuit of artificial general intelligence. title.name: The ABS-CBN tower that connected the nation (Full Documentary) | ABS-CBN News
title.overview:
Sa loob ng halos anim na dekada, naging mahalagang bahagi ng Quezon City skyline ang ABS-CBN Broadcast Tower. Mula nang maitayo ito noong 1968 sa ilalim ng pamumuno ni dating ABS-CBN President Eugenio "Geny" Lopez Jr., naging simbolo ito ng bisyong "Bridges on the Air"—ang pag-uugnay sa mga Pilipino sa iba't ibang panig ng kapuluan at ng mundo sa pamamagitan ng tapat at responsableng pamamahayag.

Tunghayan sa dokumentaryong ito ang makasaysayang papel ng Millennium Transmitter Tower: mula sa pagpapasimula ng mga makabagong teknolohiya sa telebisyon, satellite broadcast, at mga malalaking election at news coverage; ang mga pagsubok sa ilalim ng Martial Law at noong mga kaganapan ng dekada '80; hanggang sa paglipat ng network sa makabagong digital platforms kasabay ng pagbabago sa compound ng ABS-CBN sa Quezon City.

Panoorin ang mga personal na salaysay ng mga broadcast engineer, technician, at mamamahayag na sumasalamin sa dedikasyon ng network na manatiling "In the Service of the Filipino."

title.name: What TPS’ End Means for Haitians | Haiti Deportation Crisis (full documentary) | FRONTLINE (PBS)
title.overview:
The Trump administration ended Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Haitians who had fled violence and upheaval, saying that Haiti was now safe enough for them to return home. What is the reality on the ground in Haiti?

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

“Haiti Deportation Crisis” offers a rare, up-close look at the extent and impact of gang violence in Haiti, the efforts to combat it, and the rising fears among Haitians in the U.S. of being sent back.
  
In vivid detail, the documentary shows how armed gangs now control large parts of Haiti, how massacres and mass kidnappings are devastating families, and how efforts to stem the violence are playing out so far — including the work of the Gang Suppression Force, a newly-established international military mission backed by the U.N. and 18 countries including the U.S.

Unfolding against the backdrop of the end of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Haitians, what emerges is a visceral documentation of life inside a country many Haitians in the U.S. say is as dangerous as ever  — and where they fear they’ll be kidnapped, ransomed, or killed if they’re deported. The documentary also examines how the end of TPS is impacting communities in the U.S. with large Haitian populations, such as Springfield, Ohio.

“Haiti Deportation Crisis” is a FRONTLINE production with Mongoose Pictures. It is written, produced and directed by Adam Desiderio and Sebastian Walker. The correspondent is Sebastian Walker. title.name: Decoding the Universe: Quantum | Full Documentary | NOVA | PBS
title.overview:
Dive into the universe at the tiniest – and weirdest – of scales.

Official Website:  https://to.pbs.org/3CkDYDR | #novapbs 

When we look at the world at the tiniest scales in the subatomic realm, things get weird – very weird. Welcome to the quantum universe, where particles can spin in two directions at once, observing something changes it, and something on one side of the galaxy can instantly affect something on the other, as if the space between them didn’t exist. Buckle up for a wild ride through the discoveries that proved all of this to be true and paved the way for the digital technologies we enjoy today – and the powerful quantum sensors and computers of tomorrow. 

Correction: The original version of this film had misplaced punctuation, which falsely implied that in 1974, Stephen Hawking was the first to predict black holes. The film, captions, and transcript have been amended to clarify that in 1974, Stephen Hawking first predicted the phenomenon now known as Hawking radiation, referred to in the film as the “Achilles’ heel” of black holes.

title.name: Chris Hardwick | The Middle Ages (Full Comedy Special)
title.overview:
Chris Hardwick takes on middle age, marriage, fatherhood, and a rapidly changing world in an energetic stand-up performance packed with stories, songs, and audience interaction. Now in his 50s, Hardwick finds comedy in the indignities of aging, from growing pill collections and questionable digestive choices to prostate exams and realizing Gen Z are “time millionaires.”

As an older dad, Hardwick dives into the joys and exhaustion of raising his four-year-old daughter, diaper disasters, and keeping up with toddler energy while comparing her childhood to his Gen X upbringing. He also explores a decade of marriage, from movie-night frustrations and true crime obsessions to the stark contrast between his Disneyland bachelor party and his wife’s boar-hunting adventure.

Along the way, Hardwick riffs on forgotten technology, cats versus dogs, and modern life through hilarious musical numbers. The show builds to the epic “Tampon Quest,” transforming a simple errand for his wife into a fantasy adventure with an unexpected ending. Playful, nostalgic, and personal, Hardwick finds the fun in growing older without necessarily growing up.
